# Logistics 0.1.4 alpha 21

Mobile readers now share compact page controls with rounded arrows, a progress track and a page or chapter badge. Open comics use a close control, while reader tools return to their document. Reader backgrounds blend with the surrounding page.

Document edits use native save/discard/cancel dialogs. Startup restores the last active document, navigation icons are consistent across platforms, and transfer status stays available without covering the reading area.

The release also includes the Boox signing/version preflight fixes and reader, folder navigation and safe-area corrections from the preceding alpha. Android and iOS native UI tests, embedded runtime checks and desktop platform regressions are required before publication.
